name: Train Organizer

apps.name: Train Organizer
apps.subtitle: Run the platforms of a real railway station.
apps.localizedDescription: Decide which platform every train gets and who goes first, with the real timetables of Wien, Salzburg and Budapest. Beta version, actively developed by NWorks. © 2026 NWorks. All rights reserved.

versions.localizedDescription:
• Four new stations with real timetables of Tuesday 17 November 2026: Budapest-Kelenföld (MÁV), Zürich HB with the underground Löwenstrasse station (opentransportdata.swiss), München Hbf with its 32 terminal tracks and Berlin Hbf during the Stadtbahn closure (gtfs.de, CC BY 4.0).
• Sound: a station chime when a train needs a platform, a click when you set one, warnings for failures and turned-away trains, and a tune at the end of the shift. Choose the volume in the menu; the switch in the game turns it off.
• 17 achievements, shown at the end of a shift and in the menu.
• The station tiles in the menu are now in two rows, so that full names fit.
• München Hbf: the source names the hall of every train, and the game prefers those tracks.
